sentences.text:
3. The petitioner is accused No.3 in the complaint filed by the respondent No.1 under Sections 120-B, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 474 r/w 109 IPC.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that pending the Criminal Petition the trial Court proceedings have been commenced and the petitioner is resolved to face the proceedings.

Further pleaded that earlier considering the submissions as an interim measure, this Court has dispensed with his physical presence in the proceedings subject to his present as and when directed by the trial Court.
Thus, by extending the order until disposal of the Calendar Case, prayed for disposing the present petition.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor reported no specific objection.
6. I have considered the submissions of learned counsel and perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the submissions as the petitioner has prepared to stand trial and as interim measure, the physical presence of the petitioner was dispensed with, continuance of that direction until conclusion of the Calendar Case No. 17 of 2018 is not found objectionable.

8. Accordingly, the presence of the petitioner is dispensed with in the proceedings in Calendar Case No. 17 of 2018 subject to petitioner's appearance through his counsel on all adjournments and compliance of direction physical appearance by the Court concerned.
9. With the above direction, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
